facts.fact: 2019 年，Jake Jeffreyes 在 Canary Wharf 十二楼的办公室上班。
facts.anchor: Twelve floors up in his Canary Wharf office, Jake Jeffreyes stared at the time on his computer screen.

facts.fact: 他多年攀爬公司阶梯，早已发现高位上没什么乐趣。
facts.anchor: He had devoted years of his life to climbing the corporate ladder, and had realised some time ago that there was little pleasure to be found on the higher rungs.

facts.fact: 他为一家被环保人士指责破坏地球的大型石油公司工作。
facts.anchor: He worked for a large oil company that plenty of campaigners felt was killing the planet.

facts.fact: 他玩赌博应用，自称只是小赌。
facts.anchor: He only dabbled, it was nothing serious, not really.

facts.fact: 他多年没和 Matty 说过话。
facts.anchor: He hadn’t spoken to Matty for many years.

facts.fact: Charlie 在 Clapham 的派对上说自己多了个叫 Elliot 的继弟。
facts.anchor: Lucky me, I’ve now got this annoying kid stepbrother called Elliot.

facts.fact: 他多年来一直拖延与 Daisy 的婚事。
facts.anchor: He had managed to stall for years, telling her they’d get married one day.

facts.fact: 他最终接起 Matty 的电话。
facts.anchor: He picked up his phone, stepped away from his desk, took a deep breath and pressed answer.
